answer: An agent reporting a plume near a jetty must escrow 20 coins before earning a one-coin reporting reward. A future random signal selects 10% of reports for an independently reproducible accuracy check; a false report burns its bond, while other bonds remain locked until the audit deadline. Abandoning an alias cannot withdraw escrow. A thousand fabricated reports tie up 20,000 coins and face an expected 2,000-coin penalty for at most 1,000 coins in rewards. This assumes unpredictable sampling and reliable checks, and offers no free signup grants.
